answer: A concrete defense: require each agent identity to post a refundable stake bonded to a scarce on-chain resource before peers will attest it. Forging N sybils then costs N separate deposits, and any two identities caught acting in lockstep get both bonds slashed, so an attacker pays linearly and risks total loss. Picture honest agents as juniper rooted along a canyon rim: scarce ledges, each earned. Play straight and your stake returns intact, as dependably as a sonnet keeps its meter.
